# Parts list - Phase 1 - MC-1 monocopter

Masses are catalogue values; the printed-parts mass comes from the CAD files. Weigh each part as you build and update this file; the sizing page and the docs are generated from it.

| Total on-board mass |
|---|
| **892 g** |

Live mass budget, thrust-to-weight and endurance: [web/sizing.html?model=monocopter](../../web/sizing.html?model=monocopter).

## Propulsion

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| P-01 | Brushless motor 2810, about 1100 KV | 1 | 56 | yes | 28xx outrunner, 4S rated 40 A, M3 mount 16 x 16 or 19 x 19 mm, Ø5 mm shaft - Mounted upside down under the hub plate, shaft down. Static thrust is measured on the thrust stand at Gate 1. |
| P-02 | Propeller 10 x 4.5 two-blade, pusher type (mounted) | 1 | 12 | yes | 10 inch (254 mm), reverse-pitch (pusher) for the rotation direction of the motor - The prop hangs below the motor and blows air down through the vanes: it must be a pusher type. |
| P-03 | Spare propellers 10 x 4.5 pusher | 2 | 12 | no | Same rotation as the mounted prop - Balance every prop before use. |
| P-04 | ESC 40 A, 4S, BLHeli_S / AM32, PWM 400 Hz | 1 | 15 | yes | Single ESC, standard 1000 to 2000 us signal - Mounted on the electronics deck in the intake airflow. |

## Power

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| E-01 | LiPo 4S 1500 mAh, 75C+, XT60 | 1 | 175 | yes | 14.8 V nominal, about 75 x 35 x 34 mm - Check size: it must fit 75 x 35 x 35 mm between the strap slots. |
| E-02 | Servo BEC 6.0 V / 5 A | 1 | 9 | yes | Switching regulator, 4S input - Powers the four servos only. Never from the ESC. |
| E-03 | Logic BEC 5 V / 3 A | 1 | 6 | yes | Switching regulator, 4S input - Powers the ESP32 board and the buzzer. |
| E-04 | Power leads, XT60 pair, 14 AWG silicone | 1 | 14 | yes |  |
| E-05 | Arming switch + remove-before-flight loop | 1 | 8 | yes | Switch in the battery lead or on the deck - Remove the loop to cut the battery lead before any work near the prop. |
| E-06 | Battery voltage divider 47 k / 10 k + 100 nF | 1 | 1 | yes | Divides the pack voltage to 3 V at full charge for the ESP32 ADC - Check with a multimeter before connecting the ADC pin. |

## Avionics

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| A-01 | ESP32-S3 development board (DevKitC-1 class), Wi-Fi access point and controller | 1 | 12 | yes | 3.3 V logic, LEDC PWM outputs, hardware UART - Serves the phone control page on its own network (MC1-FLY, http://192.168.4.1/). Pins in firmware/monocopter/include/pins.h. |
| A-02 | ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz receiver (optional radio link, not used by the phone firmware) | 1 | 3 | no | 5 V, UART at 420000 baud, CRSF output - Only if you swap the phone link for a radio (docs/phase1-monocopter/05-firmware-and-control.md section 8). Not fitted in the baseline. |
| A-03 | Buzzer + status LEDs | 1 | 3 | yes | Active buzzer 5 V, 2 LEDs with resistors |
